question: What should I wear?
answer: Our wedding is one for fantastical glory! Wear your best fantasy cosplay/attire. If you feel uncomfortable wearing fantasy attire, traditional wedding attire (suits dresses) are acceptable.

question: Is this a child free wedding?
answer: By Odin's beard no!  We welcome all adventurers of all ages!

question: Can I bring a plus-one?
answer: The glorious halls of our union can only fit so many people! We have granted those with families/partners a number of guests they may RSVP for.

question: Will there be an open bar?
answer: We will not have alcohol and encourage people to instead enjoy the mocktender we have conscripted to serve drinks after the ceremony and during the reception!
